Field Name
Description
integration_name
Specifies the identity provider system (such as Microsoft Entra ID or Active Directory) where user permissions will be
elevated Just-In-Time.
message
Message
permission_assignment_type_name
Indicates the type of permission assignment being performed, such as Entra Role assignments or Active Directory
group memberships.
permission_name
Specifies the exact permission being assigned, such as "Global Administrator" for Entra roles.
policy_id
Policy ID
policy_name
Policy name
related_request
References the original request ID that initiated the permission change. E.g for revocation events, this links back to the
corresponding grant event.
requested_method
Indicates how the end user initiated the elevation request, such as through Microsoft Teams or during the login
process.
scope_name
Defines the boundary or context within which the permission is being granted.
tenan_tid
Tenant or Domain ID
tenant_name
Tenant or Domain name
user_id
User ID
user_justification
Contains the reason provided by the user when requesting elevated permissions.
user_name
User name
